summary: Real hyperlink (<a href>) built on react-aria-components Link, compatible with any router via RouterProvider.
whenToUse: Navigating to another page or section, including external ones.
whenNotToUse: To perform an action: use Button.
For a link that looks like a button: use LinkButton.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination. Without href a <span role="link"> is rendered: avoid it.

props.name: variant
props.description: inline is underlined within text; standalone is underlined on hover/focus.

props.name: external
props.description: Opens in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer", an icon and localized hidden text.

inherits: Props of react-aria-components Link (onPress, routerOptions, download, hrefLang…) and DOM attributes.
accessibility: Inline links are underlined: they are not distinguished by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
The external link announces “(opens in a new tab)” through translated hidden text.
responsive: Long URLs wrap without causing overflow (overflow-wrap).
commonMistakes: Generic link text (“click here”): the text must describe the destination.
